top_temples.name: Sri Gnana Saraswathi Temple
top_temples.location_note: On the banks of the Godavari river in Basara; one of only two major Saraswati temples in India, renowned for the Aksharabhyasa (initiation into learning) ritual.

top_temples.name: Pathaleshwara Temple
top_temples.location_note: Near the Saraswati temple in Basara; contains a notable 1147 CE inscription recording the installation of a deity by Nagaladevi.

top_temples.name: Sri Sita Ramachandra Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bhadrachalam's central shrine, on the banks of the Godavari; built in the 17th century by devotee Kancherla Gopanna (Bhakta Ramadasu), called the 'Ayodhya of the South'.

top_temples.name: Subramanya Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: In the heart of Bhadrachalam town, also on the banks of the Godavari, distinct from the main Rama temple.

top_temples.name: Birla Mandir
top_temples.location_note: Atop Naubath Pahad, a 280-ft hill in Hyderabad; built in 1976, one of the city's most iconic landmarks.

top_temples.name: Chilkur Balaji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Hyderabad; known as 'Visa Balaji' since devotees pray here for visa approvals.

top_temples.name: Karmanghat Hanuman Temple
top_temples.location_note: Hyderabad; built in the 12th century by Kakatiya King Prataparudra, regarded as a 'Sankat Mochana' shrine.

top_temples.name: Peddamma Temple
top_temples.location_note: Hyderabad; a popular Devi shrine blending traditional and modern architecture.

top_temples.name: Jagannath Temple, Banjara Hills
top_temples.location_note: Banjara Hills, Hyderabad; built by the Odiya community.

top_temples.name: Kondagattu Anjaneya Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Kondagattu village, Karimnagar district; hillock shrine believed to have healing powers.

top_temples.name: Kaleshwaram Mukteswara Swamy Temple
top_temples.deity: Shiva (two lingas on a single pedestal)
top_temples.location_note: Kaleshwaram, near the Godavari-Pranahita confluence in the wider Karimnagar region; unique for its dual Shiva lingas.

top_temples.name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Karimnagar district; features two primary idols known as Kottha Narasimha Swamy and Pata Narasimha Swamy.

top_temples.name: Bhimeswara Temple
top_temples.location_note: Karimnagar district; 9th-century temple built under Shaiva influence.

top_temples.name: Veera Hanuman Temple
top_temples.location_note: Karimnagar district; a locally prominent Hanuman shrine.

top_temples.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, Jamalapuram
top_temples.location_note: About 80 km from Khammam town; known as 'Chinna Tirupati', major Brahmotsavam festival.

top_temples.name: Sri Bhadrakali Sametha Veerabhadra Swamy Temple, Kallur
top_temples.location_note: About 25 km from Khammam town; one of the oldest temples in the district.

top_temples.name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Khammam Fort
top_temples.location_note: Within the historic Khammam Fort in Khammam city.

top_temples.name: Sri Ganapeshwaralayam, Kusumanchi
top_temples.location_note: Kusumanchi, Khammam district; built by Kakatiya rulers in the 12th-13th centuries, houses one of the largest Shivalingas in the state.

top_temples.name: Lord Venu Gopala Swami Temple, Kallur
top_temples.location_note: Kallur, Khammam district; built about 400 years ago by Rani Rudramma Devi, a rare Telangana temple depicting Krishna as a cowherd.

top_temples.name: Jogulamba Temple, Alampur
top_temples.location_note: Alampur, Mahbubnagar district, on the banks of the Tungabhadra; one of the 18 Shakti Peethas, part of the 7th-century Navabrahma temple complex.

top_temples.name: Sri Ranganayaka Swamy Temple, Srirangapur
top_temples.location_note: Srirangapur, Mahbubnagar district; built by Krishnadevaraya, inspired by the Srirangam Ranganatha temple.

top_temples.name: Madana Gopala Swamy Temple, Jatprole
top_temples.location_note: Jatprole, Mahbubnagar district; historically known as Jatayuvu Kshetra.

top_temples.name: Beechupalli Anjaneya Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Alampur Mandal, Mahbubnagar district, near the Krishna-Tungabhadra confluence; 16th-century idol.

top_temples.name: Umamaheshwaram Temple
top_temples.location_note: Deep within the Nallamalai forests, Mahbubnagar district; a popular medieval-era shrine.

top_temples.name: Sarangapoor Hanuman Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nizamabad; one of the town's oldest and most famous shrines.

top_temples.name: Kanteshwar Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nizamabad town; noted for its architecture and serene setting.

top_temples.name: Uttara Tirupati Kshetram
top_temples.location_note: Nizamabad; one of the oldest and most popular temples in the twin-city locality.

top_temples.name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Jankampet
top_temples.location_note: Jankampet, Nizamabad district.

top_temples.name: Dichpally Ramalayam
top_temples.location_note: About 20 km from Nizamabad; 14th-century temple built by the Kakatiya kings, notable architecture.

top_temples.name: Kaleshwara Mukteswara Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: At the confluence of the Godavari and Pranahita rivers, near Ramagundam; a well-known regional shrine reachable from Ramagundam Railway Station.

top_temples.name: Gudem Gutta Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Near Ramagundam; a locally popular pilgrimage stop.

top_temples.name: Manthani Gauthameswara Temple
top_temples.location_note: Manthani, about 40 km from Ramagundam; an ancient centre of Vedic learning.

top_temples.name: Ramagundam Ganesh Temple
top_temples.location_note: TTS Township, Ramagundam.

top_temples.name: Jagannath Temple, NTPC Township
top_temples.location_note: NTPC Township, Ramagundam.

top_temples.name: Sri Ketaki Sangameshwara Swamy Temple, Jharasangam
top_temples.location_note: Jharasangam, about 16 km from Zaheerabad in Sangareddy district; known as 'Dakshina Kashi'.

top_temples.name: Sri Ramalingeswara Swamy Temple, Nandikandi
top_temples.location_note: Nandikandi, near Sangareddy; built about 1,000 years ago by the Chalukyas, a protected monument.

top_temples.name: Sri Ujjaini Mahakali Temple
top_temples.location_note: Secunderabad, near the railway station; about 190 years old, one of the city's most visited Devi shrines.

top_temples.name: Sri Ganesh Temple
top_temples.location_note: Secunderabad; established about 200 years ago after soldiers of the Madras Regiment discovered a Ganesha idol while digging a well.

top_temples.name: Peddamma Temple, Secunderabad
top_temples.location_note: One of Secunderabad's oldest temples, over 150 years old.

top_temples.name: Nagamma Temple
top_temples.location_note: Secunderabad; one of its oldest and most revered shrines.

top_temples.name: Sri Subrahmanya Swamy Temple, Skandagiri
top_temples.location_note: Padmarao Nagar, Secunderabad; run by the Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam.

top_temples.name: Sri Raja Rajeshwara Swamy Temple
top_temples.location_note: Vemulawada's central shrine; built by a Kalyani Chalukya governor between the 11th-12th centuries.

top_temples.name: Sri Baddi Pochamma Temple
top_temples.location_note: About 1.5 km from Vemulawada bus stand, close to the main Rajarajeshwara temple; built by Rashtrakuta king Baddiga Bhupathi.

top_temples.name: Thousand Pillar Temple
top_temples.location_note: Hanamkonda, Warangal; Kakatiya-era architectural marvel with intricate stone carvings.

top_temples.name: Sri Bhadrakali Temple
top_temples.location_note: Within Warangal Fort; a fierce Devi shrine with panoramic views.

top_temples.name: Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple
top_temples.location_note: Palampet, near Warangal; UNESCO World Heritage Site, the only Indian temple named after its sculptor, Ramappa.

top_temples.name: Padmakshi Temple (Padmakshi Gutta)
top_temples.location_note: Hilltop in Hanamkonda, Warangal; originally built during the Kakatiya period.

top_temples.name: Narasimha Swamy Temple, Warangal
top_temples.location_note: A popular and historic temple within Warangal city.

top_temples.name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple (Yadadri)
top_temples.location_note: On a hillock in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district; also called Pancha Narasimha Kshetram, the town's defining shrine.

top_temples.name: Hanuman Temple, Yadagirigutta
top_temples.location_note: Positioned just beside the main entrance of the Yadadri temple complex in Yadagirigutta.
